remarks: Location, Location, Location! Wonderful opportunity to own a charming single-story pool home in one of Temple City's most desirable neighborhoods. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence offers tremendous potential to update and create your dream home. The welcoming living room opens to the classic kitchen with eating area. Two bedrooms and one full bath are located at the front of the home. Off the kitchen is a huge family room with fireplace. For easy entertaining sliding doors open to a large screened in porch which offers opportunity for expansion in several ways. Beyond the family room is the sunny master suite with full bath and dressing area. The backyard pool offers California living at it
